name: Fleet Foodbank
short_description: Fleet Foodbank at Hart Community Centre
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Emergency food parcels with referral. Open Wed and Sat 10am-2pm. Serves Fleet and Church Crookham areas.

name: Hart District Council Allotments
short_description: Hart District allotment sites in Fleet area
description: Several sites including Reading Road and Tavistock Road. Plots from £45/year. Waiting lists apply. Water and tool storage available.

name: Fleet Community Garden
description: Located behind All Saints Church. Volunteer-run growing space with raised beds. Seasonal harvest shared among volunteers and local families.
